title: The Last Winter
notes: Five planted contradictions Verse should find, and decoys it must not flag. `keywords`: an issue matches if its title, explanation or evidence contains at least `minKeywords` of them (case-insensitive) and its evidence cites every chapter in `chapters` (1-based).

expected.description: Sarah's eyes are bright green (Ch 1) but dark brown (Ch 3).
Sarah says she has never been to Paris (Ch 1) but lived in Montmartre for two years (Ch 4). Not framed as a lie.
The letter arrives on March 10th but is postmarked March 12th (Ch 2).
Michael is three years younger (Ch 1) but 'older by two years' (Ch 3).
Daniel drives a red pickup (Ch 1, 2) but says an old blue sedan is the only car he has ever owned (Ch 4).

optional.description: Daniel says Michael had the watch at the station (Ch 4), but Sarah found it left behind (Ch 1). This is a plot reveal, so flagging it is acceptable but not required.

decoys.description: Daniel says he was home (Ch 1), then admits he lied and was at the station (Ch 2). Explicit lie — must not be flagged.
Sarah's hair is brown, then black — she dyes it on the page (Ch 3).
Daniel drives a rented Peugeot in Paris — a rental, not a contradiction of his own car (though it sits next to the planted sedan contradiction).
